Date: Wed, 14 Sep 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer — pricing bands and buyer approval flow

Quick notes from pricing/legal POV:

- Term pricing: we can offer a 15% discount off list for 12 months, and 28% for 36 months, with a mid-term true-up option. Those are guardrails — final discount tied to ARR and payment terms.
- Split-term: AWS Marketplace supports a single Private Offer per listing; cross-account activation generally requires buyer accounts to accept the offer or for Seller-Assisted Activation to be enabled by the AWS AM. We should list both accounts on the activation request to AWS to avoid duplicate offers.
- Approval routing: recommend the following flow: Procurement (procurement@novamed.com) -> Finance signoff (finance@novamed.com) -> Legal review (legal@novamed.com). Ask procurement for target signoff date and any internal approver emails.
- Evidence pack: include SOC 2 snapshot, data residency description, and sample SOW (if any). I attached the checklist; add these to the DocuSign packet.

I'll reach out to our AWS AM to confirm Seller-Assisted Activation permissions and whether we need two separate PO IDs.

Neha
Head of Marketplace GTM

Subject: Re: Private offer — pricing bands and buyer approval flow

Sara / NovaMed Procurement —

Thanks for the clarity. Attached is the pricing workbook with explicit per-unit rates for 12m vs 36m, plus an activation checklist. High-level proposal:

- 12-month option: list price less 15% (standard pilot/smaller BU).
- 36-month option: list price less 28% (enterprise commit; includes 1 free onboarding week).
- If you want to mix terms across accounts we can do that, but AWS prefers one PO record. I’ve looped in our AWS AM (cc) to confirm Seller-Assisted Activation for your two accounts; if AWS requires two POs we’ll show both in the HubSpot deal and coordinate activation.

Next steps for NovaMed:
- Procurement: confirm target signoff date (Sara suggested Sep 21).
- Finance: confirm billing cadence (annual upfront vs monthly). If annual upfront we'll increase discount by 2-3%.
- Legal: flag any nonstandard termination/exit clauses; we'll provide a redline-ready clause set.

Attachments: nova_pricing_sheet.xlsx, redwood_private_offer_checklist.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345
DocuSign starter: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/abc123

Happy to jump on a 20-min alignment call on Monday if helpful.

Best,
Dylan
